validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <datamodel><data id="a1"/><data id="b1"/></datamodel>
  <state id="a"><onentry><send event="t" namelist="a1,b1"/></onentry><transition event="t" target="f"/></state><final id="f"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `namelist` separates names with spaces, not commas: `a1,b1` is not one location
notes: `namelist` is a space-separated list of data-model locations; a comma makes the list one name that is not a valid location
diagnostics.help: separate the names with spaces: `a1 b1`
